output_list.reason: Reentrancy vulnerability occurs when an invocation to call.value can call back to itself through a chain of calls, allowing unexpected repeated money transfers.
A frozen balance vulnerability exists when the contract relies on external code to set the sender's balance, potentially causing severe limitations on the contract's own operations.
The Unrestricted Ether Transfer vulnerability occurs when the contract relies on external code to transfer Ether without having its own functions to send Ether.
The Ether Strict Equality vulnerability exists when a contract uses the balance of the contract itself as the condition in a branch statement, which can be exploited for malicious behaviors.
